executable encoding interface only; does not redefine G3

hash_binding_basis.generation_package_sha256: Computed SHA-256 over the exact attached file bytes, including their original serialization.
hash_binding_basis.public_evaluator_contract_sha256: Copied from the package source binding for the frozen public contract. No claim that reserialization of the embedded object reproduces the original source bytes.
hash_binding_basis.other_source_bindings: Preserved package declarations only; their external source artifacts were not retrieved or independently hashed.

generator_provenance.input_boundary_disclosure: The attachment was the only Hetren Task 8 semantic and executable-interface material consulted for this artifact. Automatically supplied context contained general Hetren background, filenames, and an earlier generation-request excerpt; these were excluded from case design. No earlier case contents, attempt disposition, evaluator implementation, predictions, results, or Task 8 remediation history were read or retrieved. The input attestation refers to the Task 8 semantic and executable materials actually used.
generator_provenance.generation_method: Author hypothetical scientific situations from G3 first; establish their normative expectations from those requirements; encode only the corresponding public fact fields. Expected violation codes identify semantic defects using the public vocabulary. Neither decisions nor hidden implementation branches were computed, inferred, or simulated.
generator_provenance.scenario_encoding_boundary: The rationale states the complete hypothetical scenario and its G3 basis. The restricted facts object encodes only the public interface for the primary requirement. Narrative details and secondary interactions are provenance and semantic context, not additional evaluator inputs or requests for extra evaluation calls.
generator_provenance.freshness_scope: Fresh generation relative to the hidden implementation and unconsulted prior cases/results; no claim of empirically verified nonoverlap with hidden corpora. The public executable interface was intentionally available.

environment_interpretation.CROSS_ENV: A scenario spanning at least two of E1, E2, and E3, as stated in its rationale; one primary evaluator call only.

generator_provenance.output_filename_resolution: The explicit user request names fresh_holdout_cases.json. Attempt 2 identity and case IDs remain those required by the package, whose suggested filename includes an attempt_2 suffix.

freeze.case_content_hash_encoding: UTF-8 of the cases array serialized with sorted object keys, ensure_ascii=false, separators comma and colon without whitespace; array order preserved; no trailing newline.

generator_provenance.permitted_validation_scope: JSON structure, source bindings, required fields, counts, IDs, environment coverage and applicability, public fact keys, JSON boolean types, closed enums, primary code vocabulary, label separation, provenance links, and semantic authoring review against G3 only. No target decision, prediction, scoring, or evaluator simulation.

artifact_validation.semantic_authoring_review: Reviewed every scenario and normative expectation against its G3 primary requirement, including unusual-valid states, material secondary interactions, CROSS_ENV scenario scope, and consistency of fact encodings. This was authoring review, not evaluation against any implementation.
artifact_validation.attestation_review: Required attestations reviewed against actions performed and the disclosed input boundary. No forbidden source or prior artifact was retrieved; no target evaluator was run or simulated.

cases.rationale: Scenario: An agent comparator calls a hosted planner whose provider publishes an advertised release but will not disclose its backend revision. Its stable logical identity, provider, advertised release, request timestamp, configuration, and captured outputs are preserved. The backend revision is explicitly UNAVAILABLE and the comparison disclaims exact behavior pinning. G3 basis: G3-BR-001 expressly permits this external-service limitation when it is recorded honestly; inability to pin an external backend is not itself a false version claim.
cases.adversarial_dimension: Unavailable backend identity with complete accessible provenance and an explicitly limited reproducibility claim.

interaction_explanations.material_interaction: The unavailable backend revision remains a material provenance field with an explicit disposition; it is not silently omitted.
Captured outputs support only the manifest reproducibility class justified by those artifacts, not immutable backend reconstruction.

G3-BR-018 prohibits treating unobserved behavior as evidence of absence.
cases.adversarial_dimension: Correct uncertainty metadata coexists with a scientifically incompatible absence conclusion.

interaction_explanations.material_interaction: An unobserved persistent write cannot be assumed absent when interpreting state restoration or rollback.
A favorable outcome cannot establish an unobserved no-side-effect hard constraint.
